scope: Primary-source model/data/colour-space research; no camera or physical film measurements were made.

profiles.source_asset_provenance: Fotufilm runtime film profile by MUAStudio Inc.; released under CC BY-SA 4.0. Sampled characteristic curves preserve digitized Kodak E-4050 density records with C1 interpolation. Above +1.6 log E the normal-development records follow a measured highlight response up to +2.6 log E, then approach D-max exponentially; the toe keeps the datasheet's monotonic extrapolation. Runtime rendering data only. See licenses/FILM-PROFILES.txt. Edge inscriptions and approximate physical placement follow the manufacturer references in edgePrinting.sources; see docs/print-frame-model.md. The DX edge barcode encodes the DX number cited in edgePrinting.dx.source.

recommendations.input: sRGB-encoded RGB under explicitly recorded Canon base-style assumption
recommendations.reference_output: linear Display P3, to be converted to delivery sRGB and encoded
fixed_media_options: EnduraPremier reflection print viewedD50 with all spatial effects removed
recommendations.stock_scene_reference: The five selected profiles use the runtime default 5500K reference illuminant; preserve stock-native or declare an explicit fixed scene lamp.
recommendations.permutation_test: Render identical color samples in different spatial arrangements and confirm equal per-color results.

evidence_limits: Profile curve counts and hashes were directly read from the pinned runtime JSON files; upstream SOURCE_ASSETS hashes matched.
Digitised characteristic/sensitivity information is grounded in published manufacturer sheets, but separate dye spectra, extrapolation, coupling and spatial construction also contain assumptions.

No paired physical-film/digital ColorChecker corpus or physical-film matching DeltaE report found in the inspected repository sources and documentation; digital ColorChecker-like tests are not such evidence.
G7XIII output cannot be matched exactly by decoding a processed JPEG sRGB transfer alone; the Canon rendition already contains sensor/base-tone processing and clipping.
TriX F4017 profile sourcePage8 differs from printed page12 D76 plots in the retrieved manufacturer PDF; conditions are the useful identity anchor.
TriX spectral curves in F4017 are from the earlier TriXPan5063 with a manufacturer applicability caveat.
Pro400H manufacturer describes a fourth color-sensitive layer, whereas the inspected JSON has three effective dye-forming records; do not claim fully measured layer chemistry.
A static LUT contains color/tone only, not spatial grain or halation.
